    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[index])
        m = int(input[index + 1])
        index += 2
        grid = [list(map(int, input[index:index + m])) for _ in range(n)]
        index += m * n
        bad_cols = set()
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(1, m):
                if grid[i][j] < grid[i][j - 1]:
                    bad_cols.add(j - 1)
                    bad_cols.add(j)
        if not bad_cols:
            results.append("1 1")
            continue
        if len(bad_cols) > 2:
            results.append("-1")
            continue
        if len(bad_cols) == 1:
            col = list(bad_cols)[0]
            results.append(f"{col + 1} {col + 1}")
            continue
        col1, col2 = sorted(bad_cols)
        for i in range(n):
            grid[i][col1], grid[i][col2] = grid[i][col2], grid[i][col1]
            if any(grid[i][j] > grid[i][j + 1] for j in range(m - 1)):
                grid[i][col1], grid[i][col2] = grid[i ][col2], grid[i][col1]
                results.append("-1")
                break
        else:
            results.append(f"{col1 + 1} {col2 + 1}")
    print("\n".join(results))

main()
